title: QA Test Plan — agent input
description: Written by the qa-runner agent to .github/.pipeline-context/qa/<story_id>.test-plan.json, alongside a hand-drafted unified diff at .github/.pipeline-context/qa/<story_id>.new-test.diff that adds exactly one new regression test file. Consumed by scripts/run-qa-gate.js (to know which class to run) and scripts/render-qa-report.js. This file explains the test; it does not contain the test's execution result — that comes from the deterministic gate script and is never edited by the agent.

test_file.description: Repo-relative path of the new test file added by new-test.diff, e.g. src/test/java/.../EmployeeServiceDuplicateEmailTest.java. The class name (filename minus .java) is what the gate script runs.

what_it_proves.description: What this test actually asserts, and which acceptance criterion it locks in — it should fail against the pre-change code and pass against the patched code.

mocking_strategy.description: How the test avoids needing infrastructure this sandbox doesn't have, e.g. Mockito-mocking EmployeeRepository rather than a live database.

requires_live_dependency.description: Must be false for a test the gate script can actually execute in this environment. Set true only if unavoidable — the gate will still attempt it and report the real result, never assume it passed.
